summary: Frontend-only audit of the user-app dark theme. Tested at 430x900 (plus 1920x800 for /login and /dashboard) using Playwright and an automated contrast scanner (/app/tests/dark_audit.js). The scanner checks every visible text node against its real background and flags anything with contrast below 2.6:1, and it also lists light panels larger than 6000px². The body class works correctly: every user route gets pr-user-dark, all /admin routes get an empty class with a white background, and going admin -> /terms -> /admin toggles the class both ways. The bottom nav is #0F0F14, the active item is white with a violet gradient indicator, and all 5 items navigate (home/referrals/mall/community/profile). These pages are dark and readable: /login, /terms, /privacy, /dashboard (main body), /community, /profile, /bank-redeem (most of it), /my-service-charges, /notifications, /prc-statement, /usage-history, /pay-partner-store, /subscription, /mall/wishlist, and the mall product detail sheet. The admin panel (dashboard, transaction-manager, user360) looks unchanged and light. Desktop /login and /dashboard look fine. There are still several big leftover light areas and unreadable text, listed below. The worst are the global hamburger Sidebar, /register (shadcn Card), the /mall page and the amber service-fee banner, which shows on every page.

The 'Create 6-Digit PIN *' and 'Confirm 6-Digit PIN *' labels are invisible (1.10). text-gray-600/500 copy ('Join PARAS Reward...', 'By registering...', 'Already have an account?') is 2.55. pr-user-dark is added in a useEffect after mount, so the first paint matches body:not(.pr-user-dark) .bg-gray-950 and shows a cream full-screen 'Loading...' splash. public/index.html also sets body background #ffffff. This causes a flash of light before dark. Add the class synchronously in index.html/index.js based on location.pathname.

issues: body.pr-user-dark does not override the shadcn CSS variables (--background, --card, --popover, --muted, --border, --input, plus their -foreground variants at index.css:469-472). Every shadcn Card/Dialog/Popover/Select/Sheet in the user app therefore stays white while the text-*-900 remap turns its text white. Override them inside body.pr-user-dark.

The blanket remap of text-slate-900/gray-900/text-black to #F4F4F7 breaks dark text on colored chips and buttons (amber, yellow, white tiles). Consider excluding it inside .bg-amber-*, .bg-yellow-*, .bg-orange-* and gradient from-amber/yellow, or change those components to explicit colors.

Inline-style light colors (#FFFFFF, #F4F7FB, #EDF4FF, rgba(255,249,232)) and component-scoped light CSS (ParasMall.css overlay, Sidebar bg-[#fafafa]) are not caught by the class remaps. Each one needs a direct edit.

critical_code_review_comments: The theme relies on global !important class remaps plus body:not(.pr-user-dark) scoping. This misses inline styles, CSS variables (shadcn) and component CSS files. A token-based approach (CSS vars consumed by components) would be more robust.

The text-*-900 -> white remap is context-blind and inverts text on bright chips (amber/yellow/white). Expect more cases in pages not covered here (KYC, My Invoices, Support, Messages, Network Feed were not audited in depth).

success_rate.frontend: ~60% (body-class toggle, admin isolation, bottom nav and most pages pass; Sidebar, Register, Mall, Referrals lower sections and the amber banner fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/dark_audit.js (page.evaluate(open(...).read())). It returns low-contrast texts (ratio<2.6) and light panels. Helper /app/tests/dark_helpers.py has login(page, ident, pin, dest) and audit(page, name). Note: the browser_automation sandbox breaks some str builtins (str.replace/split/len with args), so avoid string methods in scripts. The audit also flags hidden off-screen Sidebar tiles (they are real issues when the drawer opens). SVG tspan (usage chart) and emoji results are false positives. The user test account has a pending ₹300 service fee, so the amber banner shows on all pages.
